name: WF-418 — Buyer Selection → Contract & Assignment Handoff Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const buyerId=String(b.buyerId??b.selectedBuyerId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,buyerId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Contract Handoff Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const buyer=ctx.buyer??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??{}; const p=ctx.property??{}; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const purchasePrice=num(d.purchasePrice??d.contractPrice); const assignmentFee=num(d.assignmentFee); const buyerOffer=num(d.buyerOffer??d.offerAmount); const protectedMao=num(d.protectedMAO??d.protectedMao); const selectedOffer=buyerOffer??num(input.buyerOffer); const flags=[]; if(ctx.dealStatus&&['closed','cancelled','disputed'].includes(String(ctx.dealStatus).toLowerCase()))flags.push('deal_protected_state'); if(buyer.active===false)flags.push('buyer_inactive'); if(buyer.suppressed===true)flags.push('buyer_suppressed'); if(buyer.dnc===true)flags.push('buyer_dnc'); if(buyer.assignmentEligible===false)flags.push('buyer_assignment_ineligible'); if(buyer.proofOfFundsVerified!==true)flags.push('proof_of_funds_not_verified'); if(seller.identityVerified!==true)flags.push('seller_identity_not_verified'); if(p.identityVerified!==true)flags.push('property_identity_not_verified'); if(d.contractReady!==true)flags.push('contract_not_ready'); if(d.sellerSigned!==true)flags.push('seller_signature_missing'); if(selectedOffer===null)flags.push('buyer_offer_missing'); if(protectedMao!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&purchasePrice>protectedMao)flags.push('purchase_price_above_protected_mao'); if(protectedMao!==null&&selectedOffer!==null&&selectedOffer<purchasePrice)flags.push('buyer_offer_below_purchase_price'); if(purchasePrice===null)flags.push('purchase_price_missing'); const blocked=flags.some(x=>['deal_protected_state','buyer_inactive','buyer_suppressed','buyer_dnc','buyer_assignment_ineligible','proof_of_funds_not_verified','seller_identity_not_verified','property_identity_not_verified','contract_not_ready','seller_signature_missing','buyer_offer_missing','purchase_price_missing'].includes(x)); const handoffType=blocked?'review_required':(selectedOffer!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&selectedOffer>=purchasePrice?'assignment_contract_handoff':'review_required'); const assignmentReady=handoffType==='assignment_contract_handoff'; const idempotencyKey='wf418:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.buyerId; return [{json:{...input,contractAssignmentHandoff:{status:assignmentReady?'ready':'blocked',handoffType,assignmentReady,selectedBuyer:{buyerId:input.buyerId,name:buyer.name??null},economics:{purchasePrice,assignmentFee,buyerOffer:selectedOffer,protectedMAO},requiredActions:assignmentReady?['prepare_assignment_contract','route_for_signatures','confirm_title_or_closing_contact','schedule_closing_handoff']:['resolve_blockers','revalidate_buyer_and_contract_readiness'],flags,confidenceScore:assignmentReady?Math.max(70,Math.min(100,100-flags.length*5)):Math.max(0,60-flags.length*5)},idempotencyKey}}];
